title: SFTP connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One SFTP instance's settings, read by the native objects family (`loams_connector_objects::sftp`, CN2 Task 13) over SSH 2 and SFTP v3. `auth.*` holds secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`: a password, or an Ed25519 or ECDSA private key (R13.6). `host_key` is required and any other server key is refused.

root.description: The directory the source reads and the sink writes under.

host_key.description: The server's public key as in `known_hosts` or `ssh-keyscan` output (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA…`); a host name before it is ignored. Not a secret.

auth.description: SSH credentials, as secret names: `password` or `private_key` is required.

password.description: The user's password. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

private_key.description: An OpenSSH private key (Ed25519 or ECDSA). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

private_key_passphrase.description: The private key's passphrase. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

prefixes.description: Several directories under `root` to read, one source split each; `prefix` when empty.

source.description: The listing source: one split per prefix, read in lexicographic key order after a high-water key.

decode.description: What each listed object becomes: one `object` event with its metadata (`metadata`) or its bytes (`bytes`), or Arrow batches decoded from CSV, NDJSON or Parquet.

columns.description: The columns of CSV and NDJSON objects, typed with the SDK's SQL type names (required for `csv` and `ndjson`; Parquet carries its own schema).

csv_header.description: CSV objects start with a header line.

poll_interval_ms.description: List again this long after a listing ends. Without it the source lists once and ends (a bounded read).

max_object_bytes.description: Objects larger than this are not decoded or carried; they go to the DLQ as poison and the listing moves past them.

decode_batch_rows.description: Rows per decoded batch before the batch budget cuts it.

sink.description: The SFTP sink: one file per Fabric batch, written as `.<name>.tmp` and published with SFTP v3 `RENAME`, which refuses an existing destination (R13.6).

roll_bytes.description: Accepted for the family's shared shape; the SFTP sink writes one file per batch.

roll_interval_secs.description: Accepted for the family's shared shape; the SFTP sink writes one file per batch.

conditional_put.description: Accepted for the family's shared shape; the rename already refuses an existing file.

raw_separator.description: Raw format: written after each event's data.

evolution.description: Accepted for the SDK's shared keys; unused by SFTP.

lossy.description: Accepted for the SDK's shared keys; unused by SFTP.
